items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: he wrote a song, Purple Rose of Cairo, and I wrote the second part of it

ctx.x: Did you play any other rags by Joplin or James Scott or?

No, no there was a fellow by the name of Piron, he was a car fellow, Almond Puyla, what was his first name? Almond J. Piron. Yeah, Almond J. Piron. And he wrote a song, Purple Rose of Cairo, and I wrote the second part of it, and we never had it published. You wrote the second part of that? Yeah. It's out?
